title: Analysis
description: The analyst's reading of a plain-text request (yk ticket new): its type, a title, and the questions the text leaves open.

confidence.description: How sure the type and the scope are; below 0.7 the questions go to a person.

title.description: A conventional-commit style title, e.g. fix(core): ...

questions.description: Only what the text and the repository do not settle; empty when nothing is open.
